control_contracts.bearish_extreme_direction_inverted_long_: Use the same population, economics, occupancy, and execution timing, but enter long at the opposing 0.01-quantile onset; this tests whether direction rather than generic option activity carries information.
control_contracts.no_action: Zero trades, zero PnL, and no capital use.
control_contracts.unchanged_v58_liquidity_sweep_long_contr: Use the frozen hourly downside-sweep reclaim entry with its own 60-bps stop, 60-bps target, and 24-hour fallback.

falsifiers: Reject the source if immutable raw pages cannot reproduce normalized unique trades or if any recursively terminal window remains truncated.
Reject the experiment if the market source has an unrepaired leading, conflicting, or greater-than-30-minute gap required by an entry or exit lifecycle.
Reject the exact candidate if either OOS partition has fewer than ten completed primary trades.
Reject the exact candidate if any OOS scenario has nonpositive net PnL, profit factor at or below one, nonpositive net excluding the largest winner, liquidation, or insolvency.
Reject the exact candidate if it fails to exceed no action, the unchanged V58 sweep, or the direction-inverted placebo in either nominal OOS partition.
Reject the exact candidate if the pooled OOS 90-percent trade-bootstrap lower confidence bound is not positive or if the one-hour delayed scenario fails.
Invalidate the experiment if current-hour trades enter their own rolling threshold, if execution precedes the frozen availability boundary, or if source or generator hashes drift.
A failed exact candidate cannot be rescued on these opened partitions by changing moneyness, maturity, trade-count, quantile, lookback, stop, target, hold, exit, sizing, or delay parameters.

delta.invalid_policy: reject nonfinite or nonpositive inputs and exclude absolute delta at or below 0.02
delta.time: instrument expiration_timestamp minus trade timestamp in years using 365 days

feature_contract.missing_hour_policy: hours below the minimum eligible trade count have no feature or signal and do not fabricate zero flow
feature_contract.opposing_onset: eligible hour directional_imbalance is at or below the causal prior 0.01 quantile and the preceding eligible hour was above its causal 0.01 quantile
feature_contract.price_filter: none; direction must originate from option flow rather than reopen a rejected price-breakout family
feature_contract.primary_onset: eligible hour directional_imbalance is at or above the causal prior 0.99 quantile and the preceding eligible hour was below its causal 0.99 quantile

hypothesis: An extreme completed-hour imbalance of taker buying in short- and medium-dated out-of-the-money BTC calls relative to puts, with taker selling of puts contributing the same bullish sign, may precede positive BTC perpetual returns because informed directional demand can appear in leveraged options before it is fully incorporated into the underlying market.

instrument_dictionary_revision.reason: The bulk expired-instrument snapshot omitted names present in the immutable trade source; exact official name lookups are required.

known_uncertainties_and_failure_modes: Academic evidence supports information in option flow but does not establish profitable BTC-perpetual timing under this exact feature or current regime.
Volatility-motivated option trading can dominate directional trading, making the sign decomposition noisy.
Covered-call selling, protective-put buying, spread legs without identifiers, and inventory transfer can mimic directional flow.
Public history lacks bitemporal receipt and revision metadata; the 60-second availability delay is conservative but not a historical receipt proof.
Trade IV and Black-Scholes delta are model-dependent and can misclassify inverse options near expiry or during jumps.
Daily API windows may truncate unless recursively split and verified.
The 0xArchive historical boundary prevents a longer Hyperliquid-native return sample under the current account and endpoint.
All BTC price paths in the main evaluation period have already informed other research, increasing selection and multiple-testing risk.
Bar replay cannot prove exact BBO ordering, market impact, or live endpoint latency.
A 100-bps stop at 5000 USD notional can lose roughly 50 USD before fees, slippage, and funding; this is material relative to a 5000 USD bankroll.

multiple_testing_disclosure.interpretation_limit: A positive historical result is selected joint evidence, not a pristine forecast, and cannot bypass future-only capture.

partitions.partition_rule: entry timestamp selects the partition; source warmup and purge intervals may update causal rolling state but cannot open a trade

problem_restatement: The current BTC roster cannot enter an ordinary bullish move: its two Hulk routes are short-only and its sole long route requires a rare downside sweep. Test one materially distinct directional-information mechanism without relaxing or renaming a rejected price-based family.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Acquire and reproduce the exact missing-name instrument supplement, then re-run source registration before computing candidate signals.

missing_name_supplement.selection: exact left-anti-join names from bound completeness audit

deribit_instruments.raw_evidence: store the immutable raw response and checksum

deribit_trades.analysis_filter: event timestamp inside the half-open analysis window
deribit_trades.availability_semantics: a completed UTC hour is unavailable to the candidate until 60 seconds after the hour boundary
deribit_trades.deduplication: trade_id must be globally unique within the acquired currency window
deribit_trades.pagination: begin with one UTC-day half-open window; recursively bisect any window returning has_more=true; reject a one-millisecond window that remains truncated
deribit_trades.raw_evidence: store immutable gzip JSON pages and page checksums before normalization

hyperliquid_btc_minutes.cadence_policy: report all gaps; allow only explicitly labeled zero-volume repairs bounded to at most 30 consecutive minutes and reject any leading, conflicting, or longer gap

hyperliquid_funding.semantics: exact event-time funding rows applied only while the modeled position is open

source_contract.revision_policy: All downloaded bytes, normalized outputs, manifests, generator hashes, and retrieval timestamps are immutable. Any source drift requires a new registered source revision rather than overwriting this experiment.

source_revision.reason: The original candle window has gaps above the frozen 30-minute repair bound; the later source window has only bounded internal gaps.

strategy_contract.entry: enter on the next Hyperliquid one-minute open after the completed-hour primary onset becomes conservatively available
strategy_contract.intrabar_collision_policy: if stop and target are both touched in one minute without tick ordering, record the stop first
strategy_contract.portfolio_competition: standalone economics first; only a passing candidate is replayed against all V58 BTC routes and shared portfolio occupancy
strategy_contract.same_direction_reentry: requires the primary extreme state to reset below its causal upper threshold and no open BTC position
strategy_contract.strategic_exit: exit on the next one-minute open after a completed-hour opposing onset becomes conservatively available
